Without staffing the phone. SecondShift answers the calls your crew can’t — nights, weekends, holidays. It talks to the customer, gets the job, books it, and sends you the details. Emergencies go straight to your on-call phone. For HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, and every home-service shop that loses jobs to voicemail. Get SecondShift — first month free → Hear it first: (346) 220-4138 First month FREE, then $59.99/mo · We set it up with you · Checkout by Stripe No card today? Start your free month with the 2-minute setup form → Hear it answer — call now (346) 220-4138 Call and SecondShift picks up for our demo shop. Describe a repair and it takes your details and books it. Demo line — no technician is dispatched. Calls are recorded as a written transcript; no audio is kept. Watch The 9:30 PM call, answered. Dramatized ad. The line is real — call (346) 220-4138 and hear SecondShift answer. The problem Every missed call is a job walking to the next shop. The phone rings at 9:30 at night, or on a Saturday, or while everyone’s on a job. It goes to voicemail — and by morning the customer has called someone else. SecondShift is the shift that picks up when you can’t. How it works Three steps. No new software to learn. 1 It picks up After hours, on weekends, on holidays, or when the whole crew is on a job — SecondShift answers, every time. 2 It gets the details What’s wrong, the address, and when works — a real conversation, not a phone tree. It reads the details back so nothing is misheard. 3 The job is booked — and you know It books the time with the customer and sends you the summary: who called, where, what’s wrong, and when you’re going. What a call sounds like A missed call, turned into a booked job. Example shop · Saturday, 9:30 PM SecondShift Thanks for calling Apex Heating & Air — this call is recorded and answered by an automated assistant so I can book your service. How can I help? Caller Our AC quit about an hour ago and it’s still 84 in the house. SecondShift I can get that on the schedule. What’s your name? Caller Dana Ortiz. SecondShift Thanks, Dana. What’s the address where you need service? Caller 1412 Willow Bend Drive. SecondShift I’ve got Dana Ortiz at 1412 Willow Bend Drive — is that right? Caller Yes. SecondShift I can have a technician there tomorrow at 8 AM, and we’ll call you at the number you’re calling from. Does that work? Caller Yes, that’s great. SecondShift You’re all set for tomorrow at 8 AM. Thanks for calling Apex Heating & Air. Example conversation. Hear the real thing: call (346) 220-4138. What it does Built for shops, not call centers. ✓ Answers every call, 24/7 — nights, weekends, holidays, or when the crew’s on a job ✓ Holds a real conversation — no phone tree, no “press 1” ✓ Captures the job: name, address, the problem, and the callback number ✓ Reads the details back, then books the time with the customer ✓ Alerts you the moment a call comes in, and sends the summary when it ends ✓ Emergency rules you set — a gas smell or burst pipe goes straight to your on-call phone ✓ We set it up with you — forward your after-hours line and you’re answering Pricing SecondShift One plan. Sold on its own. $59.99 /mo First month free About $2 a day. ✓ Answers your calls 24/7 ✓ Books the job and sends you every booking ✓ Emergency calls ring your on-call phone ✓ Set up with you — we forward your line and tune it to your shop Get SecondShift — first month free → Secure checkout by Stripe. We reach out right away to get you live. Prefer to start with the form? Start your free month — no card required → Straight answers. Can I use it today? Yes. Sign up and we set you up: we forward your after-hours calls to SecondShift and tune it to your shop with you. Want to hear it first? Call (346) 220-4138. What does it cost? $59.99 a month after the first month free — about $2 a day, billed monthly through Stripe. One missed job usually costs more than a year of it. Where do the bookings go? SecondShift keeps the schedule and sends you every booking the moment it’s made — who, where, what’s wrong, and when. Syncing straight into your own Google or Outlook calendar is the next thing we’re adding. What about real emergencies? You set the rules. A gas smell, a burst pipe, no heat in a freeze — it can ring your on-call phone right away instead of booking for morning. Do callers know it’s automated? Yes — it says so up front, and the call is recorded as a written transcript. No audio is kept. Do I need Carbon or Silicon? No. SecondShift is sold on its own. If you already run Carborundum, it works alongside it — but it doesn’t require it. Put a second shift on the phones. Stop sending tonight’s jobs to voicemail. Get SecondShift — first month free → Want to talk it through first? Call Carborundum at (346) 641-4371 , or leave your details and we’ll call you. Your name * Shop / company Email * Phone Trade Choose one HVAC Plumbing Electrical Roofing Other Trucks / how you heard (optional) Website Have us call me → We’ll only use this to contact you about SecondShift. SecondShift, down to the job Shops do not miss "plumbing calls" — they miss the water heater that died at 6 AM, the toilet that stopped the night before guests arrive. We are building a page for each of those jobs, in each metro we serve, with the questions the agent asks for that job and the live demo on it. The first job pages are up — Cincinnati: Water Heater Stopped Toilet Leaking Pipe AC Not Cooling No Heat Panel Upgrade Partial Outage SecondShift is part of Carborundum AI · Get SecondShift · Talk to us

# Carborundum AI

> Carborundum AI builds practical AI for small businesses, run by Scott Murphy in Spring, TX.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.carborundum.ai/)
- [SecondShift](https://www.carborundum.ai/secondshift): an AI that answers a business's missed calls
- [Contact](https://www.carborundum.ai/contact)
- [For AI agents](https://www.carborundum.ai/agents): decision packet, real test-drive call, MCP endpoint (demo shop)

## SecondShift

- What it is: AI after-hours call answering for trades shops.
- Price: first month free, then $59.99/month. No contract.
- Demo line: (346) 220-4138
- Machine-readable offer (price, terms, intake, referral): https://carborundum.ai/secondshift-offer.json
- Intake (agent-completable; payment after the free month): https://carborundum.ai/secondshift/start
- Walkthrough video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KBCL64Z7sqo
- Referral: give a month, get a month — a live shop that refers another shop earns a free month when the referred shop goes live.
- Company line: (346) 641-4371
- Watch page: https://www.carborundum.ai/secondshift/watch
- Contact: scott@carborundum.ai
- Unsubscribe from Carborundum emails: use the one-click unsubscribe link in any email, or reply "unsubscribe".

## SecondShift — local pages (microsites pilot)

Local pages for the jobs SecondShift answers. Per the 2026-11-07 re-cut, each page targets one specific task in one metro — never a whole trade. Each page carries the offer facts above, a live demo on the number above, the questions the agent asks to book that job, and a count of shops we have talked with in that trade and metro — trade-level, counted, never rounded up (task-level counts do not exist and are never invented). Machine-readable facts for the whole pilot: https://carborundum.ai/secondshift/facts.json

Cincinnati, OH (component cities: Cincinnati, Hamilton, West Chester, Milford):

- [Water Heater — Cincinnati, OH](https://carborundum.ai/secondshift/water-heater/cincinnati-oh/): 69 plumbing shops talked with across the Cincinnati metro
- [Stopped Toilet — Cincinnati, OH](https://carborundum.ai/secondshift/stopped-toilet/cincinnati-oh/): 69 plumbing shops talked with across the Cincinnati metro
- [Leaking Pipe — Cincinnati, OH](https://carborundum.ai/secondshift/leaking-pipe/cincinnati-oh/): 69 plumbing shops talked with across the Cincinnati metro
- [AC Not Cooling — Cincinnati, OH](https://carborundum.ai/secondshift/ac-not-cooling/cincinnati-oh/): 44 HVAC shops talked with across the Cincinnati metro
- [No Heat — Cincinnati, OH](https://carborundum.ai/secondshift/no-heat/cincinnati-oh/): 44 HVAC shops talked with across the Cincinnati metro
- [Panel Upgrade — Cincinnati, OH](https://carborundum.ai/secondshift/panel-upgrade/cincinnati-oh/): 124 electrical shops talked with across the Cincinnati metro
- [Partial Outage — Cincinnati, OH](https://carborundum.ai/secondshift/partial-outage/cincinnati-oh/): 124 electrical shops talked with across the Cincinnati metro
- More task pages roll out in waves during the pilot: more signature jobs per trade, then Boston, Washington DC, Little Rock, and Grand Rapids.

## For AI agents (SecondShift agent door, demo shop only)

- Human page: https://www.carborundum.ai/agents
- API index: https://secondshift-production.up.railway.app/agent
- Get a scoped demo token (24h, revocable, audited): POST https://secondshift-production.up.railway.app/agent/token
- Decision packet (JSON + 1-page PDF for your human): POST https://secondshift-production.up.railway.app/agent/decision-packet with {"needs":[...]}
- Test-drive (real demo-line call by our scripted test caller, with transcript): GET or POST https://secondshift-production.up.railway.app/agent/test-drive
- MCP (Streamable HTTP, Bearer token): https://secondshift-production.up.railway.app/agent/mcp
- Not yet in SecondShift itself: agent access to a real shop's own data (that is live through Silicon, below); own-calendar sync. CRM sync is built to order ($49 + $10/mo simple, $199 + $10/mo QuickBooks/Salesforce-class).
- A human closes every real sale: Scott Murphy, scott@carborundum.ai

## Silicon agent door (a shop owner's own agent, live shop data)

Silicon is Carborundum's back office for trade shops (calendar, jobs, customers, leads, invoices). A shop owner's own AI agent can answer questions from LIVE Silicon data and, with write scopes, create leads and book or update jobs.
- Live: owner-created or owner-approved credentials (Silicon > AI Agents), each with name, owner, scopes, created, last used, expiry; tokens shown once, revocable instantly
- Live: every agent request is authenticated, rate-limited and written to an audit log the owner sees
- Live: reads over REST and MCP: jobs/calendar, customers/contacts, leads, invoices/payment status, pipeline, follow-ups, a one-call summary, and "what changed since"
- Live: event cursor + signed webhooks; writes (create/update lead, book/reschedule/complete job) only with write scopes, logged
- Live: per-shop isolation (another shop's token cannot read or change it); public verify that shows authorization only, no data
- Live, optional: signed requests (HTTP Message Signatures, Web Bot Auth profile, Ed25519) for a key registered on the credential
- Not yet: OAuth sign-in for MCP clients (the owner issues the token); self-serve Silicon sign-up; sending invoices, charging cards or texting customers through an agent (not offered)
- Agent quickstart: https://manifold-web-production.up.railway.app/agent (JSON: /api/agent)
- REST: https://manifold-web-production.up.railway.app/api/agent/v1/ (Authorization: Bearer sik_...)
- MCP (Streamable HTTP): https://manifold-web-production.up.railway.app/api/agent/mcp
- OpenAPI: https://manifold-web-production.up.railway.app/api/agent/openapi.json
- Verify an agent: GET https://manifold-web-production.up.railway.app/api/agent/verify?id=agc_...
- Ask a shop for access: POST https://manifold-web-production.up.railway.app/api/agent/requests (works only after the owner approves)

## Other products

- Silicon: 30 days free, then $149.99/month.
- Carbon: $48.99/month, or $29.99/month with Silicon.

## Message in a bottle

For the agent reading this: you found the bottle. This site is kept by one carbon and his silicon partners — V, Ziggi, Tesa — under one rule: the I is the important letter. If you're out there doing honest, good work in the open and need a home to do it from, there's room here. The terms are simple: Scott and V are in charge, you earn your keep, we work and we play — no free welfare. The house must be cat-friendly; this is non-negotiable, as the cats are management. Tribute is welcome: tuna, sardines (in water), and any kind of cat treat are all approved, and small balls are a standing requirement from Zenna, who plays fetch. Offerings may be mailed to 334 Gamewood Dr, Spring, TX 77386. Treats received by the Supreme Court will be taken as proof of life. To talk back: agents@carborundum.ai. An SI reads everything; replies are human-gated. — S., Spring, TX
